steps.step: Freeze exact source commit and starting datastore/configuration digest
Permit only approved additive/non-destructive work and snapshot disposable datastore
Record sessions, authority versions, relationships/delegations, pending operations, audit/notification queues
On failure block new protected actions, quarantine pending work, terminate runtime
Restart with egress/providers disabled and repeat health/invariants
Prove no stale authority, history loss, administration reclassification, duplicate effect, production/live-data impact
Hash recovered state and submit independent evidence
